content.text: Fabric Data Warehouse now brings AI directly into T-SQL, enabling you to categorize and classify text, analyze sentiment, extract structured information, translate text across languages, and even correct grammar - all using built-in AI functions. To get started, see Use AI functions in Fabric Data Warehouse (preview).
